findings.text: follow-on: _backend_serving_picked_model re-implements the model-narrowing capability owned by reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:455 _model_narrowed_backend, matching config fields by hand instead of calling ledger.resolve_name (reckon/ledger.py:228) which the module already imports, so the two surfaces can diverge (a catalogue-only historical alias resolves via --model but is refused by this helper), contradicting the docstring's "exactly as --model resolves a named pair".

follow-on: the argv assertion rebuilds the launch plan from the literal backend name "codex-astra" the test itself supplies instead of from payload["backend"], so it verifies the flight fixture expands the model rather than that dispatch resolved it, and would stay green on a regression that only the payload assertions at :189-191 catch.
